notes.title: Patch 1.0.3
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Falling trough the map will now teleport you back up
[*] Gave the guy in the lab a book to read
[*] You can now "kill" enemies
[*] Inverted controls options now apply to vechicles
[/list]

notes.title: Patch 1.0.2
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug were the snowmobile kept moving after exit
[*] Fixed some sound bugs
[*] [strike]Added microtransactions shop[/strike]
[*] Added X and Y inverted mouse options
[/list]

notes.title: Patch 1.01
notes.content:
Small patch fixing some of the more common bugs.

[list]
[*] Fixed a bug where the snowmobile glitches and flies out of the map
[*] Fixed a bug where the briefcases stay in air after turning in
[*] Fixed a bug where enemy can still attack player on snowmobile
[*] Made it a bit harder to fall trough the world
[/list]
